title: Here's why you shouldn't take gap insurance on your car
summary: A consumer-advocacy news segment explains gap insurance's real benefit and its catches, including that it doesn't cover extended warranty costs and can falter on long loans.

assertions.quote: it won't cover the cost of an extended warranty

verdicts.note: Gap insurance is designed to cover the difference between loan balance and vehicle value, not warranty costs, which is standard across policies.

assertions.quote: it may not cover the longest seven-year loans

verdicts.note: Some gap policies do cap eligible loan terms, but this is not universal across all providers, so it depends on the specific policy purchased.

assertions.quote: it's good to have if your down payment is less than 20 percent of the cost
you'll still be monk making monthly payments on what will really be an old car at the end of those seven years

verdicts.note: Vehicles depreciate fastest early on, so stretching a loan over more years keeps the balance above the depreciating vehicle's value for longer, a well-established negative-equity dynamic.
